jobs.description:
**Quality Assurance Compliance Analyst \- Remote CA**
=====================================================

Date: Sep 21, 2026
Location:
West Sacramento, CA, US, 95605\-1630


Req ID: 37880
Work Mode: Virtual (Exception only)
Great companies need great teams to propel their operations. Join the group that solves business challenges and enhances the way we work and grow. Working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values your contributions and puts a premium on work flexibility, learning, and career development.

  

**Summary**
-----------


As a **Quality Assurance Compliance Analyst** at Gainwell, you will support quality and compliance activities across healthcare operations for the Medi\-Cal account. You will review claims and operational processes, analyze data to identify quality trends and potential issues, and help ensure work is completed accurately and in accordance with established policies, regulatory requirements, and organizational standards.


You will partner with claims, clinical, compliance, and operational teams to identify opportunities for improvement and strengthen overall quality and performance.


**Your role in our mission**
----------------------------


* Conduct quality reviews and audits of healthcare claims and operational processes to evaluate accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* Analyze claims data to identify trends, anomalies, coding errors, quality issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Review claims, denials, appeals, provider enrollment, and related operational activities to validate data accuracy and identify potential compliance or quality concerns.
* Document audit findings, maintain appropriate audit trails, analyze quality metrics, and communicate findings to operational and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Participate in root\-cause analysis and recommend corrective actions and process improvements based on audit findings and identified trends.
* Support compliance and regulatory reporting, internal and external audits, and quality improvement initiatives in collaboration with claims, clinical, compliance, and operational teams.
**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* High school diploma or GED required; bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience preferred.
* Three or more years of experience in quality assurance, compliance, auditing, healthcare operations, claims, or a related field.
* Experience with healthcare claims adjudication, claims validation, denials, appeals, billing, or related healthcare operational processes.
* Knowledge of common claims quality issues, coding errors, and healthcare quality or compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with Medicaid or Medi\-Cal operations and regulatory requirements, including DHCS or other applicable state regulatory or accreditation requirements, preferred.
* Experience analyzing data, identifying trends, conducting root\-cause analysis, and supporting process improvement initiatives.
* Experience maintaining quality documentation, audit findings, and audit trails.
* Knowledge of systems such as EDMS, NICE CXone, or MMIS is a plus.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, and communication skills with excellent attention to detail.
**What you should expect in this role**
---------------------------------------


* This position is primarily remote, with occasional in\-office requirements at our West Sacramento, CA office based on business needs.
* Candidates must reside in California and be able to report to the West Sacramento office as needed.
* Travel requirements of approximately 0–10%.
* Video cameras must be used during all interviews.
  

We will be accepting applications for this position until **October 2, 2026\.**


\#LI\-REMOTE


\#LI\-MA1

  

The pay range for this position is $53,900\.00 \- $77,000\.00 per year, however, the base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region, internal equity, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Put your passion to work at Gainwell. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. All salaried, full\-time candidates are eligible for our generous, flexible vacation policy, a 401(k) employer match, comprehensive health benefits, and educational assistance. We also have a variety of leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

  

We believe nothing is impossible when you bring together people who care deeply about making healthcare work better for everyone. Build your career with Gainwell, an industry leader. You’ll be joining a company where collaboration, innovation, and inclusion fuel our growth. Learn more about Gainwell at our company website and visit our Careers site for all available job role openings.

jobs.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we've consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.



We're passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game\-changing solutions for our clients, and we're always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.


**The Role**



The Global Senior Financial Analyst supports the monthly consolidation and close process while serving as a key financial planning and analysis partner to the business. Approximately 30% of the role is focused on consolidation and close activities, including reviewing regional submissions, validating intercompany activity, supporting consolidation entries, and ensuring accurate and timely monthly financial reporting. Approximately 70% of the role is focused on FP\&A, including budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, variance analysis, management reporting, and providing actionable insights to business leaders.

* Support the monthly consolidation and close process, including review of regional/entity submissions, consolidation entries, and completeness and accuracy of reported financial results
* Review and analyze intercompany balances and activity; partner with Accounting and regional finance teams to resolve discrepancies and support timely eliminations
* Perform close\-related financial reviews, including account and P\&L analytics, flux analysis, and validation of consolidated results prior to management reporting
* Partner with business leaders to develop the annual budget and prepare monthly forecasts, including revenue, operating expenses, headcount, and key business drivers
* Conduct complex financial analyses and build financial models to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and recommendations that inform business decisions
* Prepare monthly management reporting, including financial results, KPIs, budget\-to\-actual and forecast variance analysis, with clear explanations of key business drivers
* Support department and business leaders in managing P\&L performance through ongoing financial partnership, scenario analysis, and evaluation of strategic initiatives
* Analyze historical performance, operational drivers, and relevant industry trends to improve revenue and expense forecasting and support long\-range planning
* Prepare and present variance explanations and financial insights for monthly P\&L, Financial Review, and Budget meetings; update and publish supporting presentations
* Serve as a financial resource to business partners on budget, forecast, transactional, and ad hoc analytical questions, including evaluation of financial impacts and recommended actions

  

  

  

**Qualifications**
* BA/BS Degree (4\-year) Finance, Accounting, or relevant field of study
* 4\-6 years' experience in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, consolidation, and/or accounting
* Prior experience with planning and consolidation solutions, Oracle, Hubble, OneStream, or similar financial systems desired
* Advanced Excel, Modeling, and PowerPoint skills and ability to learn required business systems
* Working knowledge of budgeting, financial analysis, financial modeling, working knowledge of accounting principles
* Demonstrates experience with financial systems and ability to work with large amounts of data
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem\-solving skills with great attention to details
* Able to work independently and complete duties and projects under minimal direct supervision
* Employee may be required to work seasonal overtime to support the business needs of the company

At all levels, our Cost Analyst will utilize their skills in cost estimating/analysis as well as in program management to support the development and procurement of space launch vehicles for the National Security Space Community. jobs.title: Buyer / Production Planner
jobs.description:
**Location:** Santa Clara, CA  
**Job Type:** Full\-time, On\-site

**About Us:**

ESP Safety Inc. is a manufacturer of industrial flame and gas detection systems serving the oil and gas, energy, petrochemical, and industrial markets worldwide.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on Buyer / Production Planner to manage production requirements, material planning, purchasing, and inventory availability at our Santa Clara manufacturing facility.

The successful candidate will work directly with our manufacturing team to translate customer sales orders into production requirements, identify material shortages, and ensure components are available to support manufacturing schedules.

This position requires someone who can independently manage both production planning and purchasing, rather than specializing in only one of these functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Production Planning**

* Review open customer sales orders and identify outstanding manufacturing requirements.

**Purchasing \& Material Planning**

* Calculate material shortages based on production requirements, available inventory, and incoming materials.
* Prepare purchase orders and coordinate supplier deliveries.
* Monitor open purchase orders, supplier lead times, and material availability.
* Expedite critical components to support production schedules.
* Coordinate purchasing priorities with Production and Finance.

**Inventory \& ERP Reconciliation**

* Verify inventory availability and investigate discrepancies between physical inventory and ERP records.
* Review outstanding purchase orders and identify incorrect, duplicate, or outdated records.
* Reconcile production requirements with existing Pending Builds and inventory commitments.
* Maintain accurate purchasing and material planning information.
* Assist with implementing and improving inventory and production planning procedures.
* Review existing assembly builds and create or update Pending Builds in QuickBooks Enterprise.
* Plan production quantities and coordinate manufacturing schedules with the Production Manager.
* Work with multi\-level bills of materials (BOMs) and manufacturing assemblies.
* Identify component requirements across multiple production orders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Hands\-on experience in both production planning and purchasing within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience working with multi\-level BOMs, manufacturing work orders, and material requirements planning.
* Experience managing purchase orders and supplier delivery schedules.
* Ability to independently identify material shortages and verify inventory availability.
* Experience with manufacturing ERP systems and inventory reconciliation.
* Strong Excel and analytical skills.
* Ability to work full\-time on\-site in Santa Clara.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with QuickBooks Enterprise manufacturing and inventory functions.
* Background in electronics, instrumentation, industrial equipment, or electromechanical manufacturing.
* Experience improving manufacturing planning and purchasing processes.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a hands\-on professional who can independently manage production and purchasing requirements, investigate inventory discrepancies, and work directly with our manufacturing team to ensure materials are available when needed.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a manufacturing environment where accurate planning requires both ERP analysis and verification of actual inventory and supplier commitments.

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

**Work Location:** Santa Clara, California — On\-site.

ESP Safety is an equal opportunity employer.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* 1\. Describe your experience in production planning for a manufacturing company.

A. I have independently managed production planning from customer orders through work orders, material requirements, and production scheduling.

B. I have managed production schedules and work orders but relied on another department for material planning.

C. I have performed material planning based on production schedules prepared by others.

D. I have supervised production planning teams but have limited hands\-on planning experience.

E. I have no direct manufacturing production planning experience.

* 2\. Describe your experience with purchasing and purchase order management.

A. I have independently managed purchasing based on production requirements, including identifying shortages, creating POs, managing suppliers, and tracking deliveries.

B. I have managed purchasing and suppliers but received material requirements from a separate planning department.

C. I have prepared POs and followed up with suppliers based on purchasing instructions from others.

D. I have supervised purchasing activities but have limited hands\-on purchasing experience.

E. I have no direct manufacturing purchasing experience.

* 3\. Describe your experience managing production and purchasing when ERP inventory and purchasing records are inaccurate or incomplete.

A. I have independently established production and purchasing requirements by reconciling sales orders, work orders, BOMs, physical inventory, and supplier commitments before relying on ERP reports.

B. I have independently investigated inventory and purchasing discrepancies and corrected the records before using ERP reports for planning.

C. I have identified discrepancies and worked with inventory or purchasing teams to resolve them.

D. I have primarily relied on ERP\-generated inventory and material shortage reports to plan production and purchasing.

E. I have not worked in an environment with significant inventory or purchasing record discrepancies.

Work Location: In person

OverviewSmalls is a premium DTC cat food and cat lifestyle brand built on a single belief: the cats who matter most to their people deserve food that actually reflects that. We're looking for a Financial Analyst to sit at the intersection of finance and operations, providing financial analysis, reporting, and business partnering across functions. You'll support and provide leverage to our Strategic Finance Manager, particularly on core recurring and strategic forecasting and planning work — turning business strategy into numbers leadership can trust.


This is an individual contributor role with a growth path to Senior Analyst, for someone who wants FP\&A to inform operational and strategic decisions at a time to actually effect change, not after the fact.


**What This Role Is**
---------------------


This is the person who takes ownership of the recurring FP\&A engine so our Strategic Finance Manager can spend more time on strategic work. You'll own components of the budgeting and in\-year re\-forecast cycle end to end — data gathering, financial modeling, and variance analysis — and support financial close by producing source materials and coordinating accurate, timely accruals with cross\-functional partners. You'll also build out the automated reporting and FP\&A processes that let a lean finance team punch above its weight, leveraging AI tools, FP\&A software, or both.


**What This Role Is Not**
-------------------------


**A generalist role** — this requires explicit finance and financial modeling experience, not broad operational exposure. That said, some appetite to flex beyond core FP\&A for ad\-hoc analysis is a plus — the line is finance grounding, not rigidity.


**An over\-indexed strategic seat** — the team already has strong strategic thinking; this role needs someone tactical and methodical who can own the mechanics of forecasting and reporting.


**Who You Are**
---------------


* You hold a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* You have 2–4 years of experience in financial analysis, FP\&A, accounting, or a related analytical role.
* Your Excel and financial modeling skills are advanced — you can build a forecast and variance analysis from scratch.
* You have a solid grasp of the three financial statements and the drivers behind them; you can connect operational KPIs to financial line items.
* You are a strong communicator who can explain a variance to non\-finance stakeholders and collaborate effectively with partners across a range of financial backgrounds — we're a lean team with no translation layer, so this matters especially in partnering closely with Operations.
* Nice to have:


	+ Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) and experience automating finance\-specific workflows or otherwise using AI to improve your output.
	+ BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) and/or a planning tool (Vena, Pigment, Data Rails, Cube).
	+ ERP exposure. (Netsuite) — if coming from the accounting side, auditing exposure is preferred over implementation exposure.)

* **Very Competitive Benefits:** Fully paid Health, Vision, and Dental insurance. 4\-day work week. Unlimited PTO.

Compensation Range: $110K \- $130K

jobs.title: Sr. Financial Analyst, Program Finance
jobs.description:
**Why Renovo?**  

Renovo Solutions is a nationwide healthcare and life sciences technology management company. We offer a range of opportunities for employees to grow within the company. With a presence in 40\+ states and a growing international footprint, we provide comprehensive solutions for managing and maintaining the equipment our clients depend on. We prioritize investing in our employees’ development, offering various phases and advancement paths. Through ongoing training, mentorship programs, and a supportive work environment, we foster professional growth and promote from within. Join our team to make a difference while advancing your career with Renovo.  

  

**Summary:**  

The Senior Finance Analyst, Program Finance owns the financial position of the Enterprise Laboratory Instrument Services (ELIS) program: the profit and loss, the budget cycle, the billing accuracy and the savings the program claims. The seat also owns the arithmetic behind any commercial claim the program makes.  

  

The role reports to the Director of Sourcing and Payments, leads the Finance Analysts, and partners with the Regional Directors of Operations on the regional profit and loss, the Program Analyst on operational analysis, and the Accounts Payable Coordinators on the spend position.  

  

**What you will do:**  

Program profit and loss:  

  

Own the program profit and loss, including labor, parts, travel, tooling and vendor pass\-through.  

  

Own the monthly close for the program, including accruals, prepayments and reconciliation to the general ledger.  

  

Analyze and explain margin performance by region, site and service line.  

  

Own the forecast and the re\-forecast and explain the variance rather than restating it.  

  

Flag margin erosion early, including where delivered scope has grown beyond the priced baseline.  

  

**Billing and revenue:**  

  

Own billing accuracy against the contractual pricing structure, including named headcount, rate lines and pass\-through mechanics.  

  

Confirm every billed line traces to a contractual basis before the invoice is issued.  

  

Own the billing calendar and the resolution of any client query on a billed amount.  

  

Own revenue recognition for the program in line with Renovo policy.  

  

Own the commercial mechanics agreed with the client, including invoicing frequency, payment terms and any float position.  

  

**Commercial case support:**  

  

Own the financial arithmetic behind change orders, material scope changes and pricing proposals.  

  

Build the cost basis for a new or expanded scope from actual loaded cost rather than an assumed rate.  

  

Own the savings baseline, so any saving claimed to the client traces to a prior contract price or prior labor cost.  

  

Model the financial effect of self\-perform and RenovoCare conversion, including the step cost of hiring whole heads against fractional demand.  

  

Provide the financial view in client business reviews and in internal commercial decisions.  

  

**Budget and planning:**  

  

Own the annual budget cycle for the program with the Regional Directors and the sites.  

  

Provide site\-level budget and spend data in a form site leadership can use rather than only report.  

  

Own the headcount cost model, including loaded cost, burden and rate build.  

  

Support workforce and capacity planning with the cost consequence of each option.  

  

**Leading the function and control:**  

  

Lead the Finance Analysts, including work allocation, development and performance management.  

  

Own financial controls for the program, including approval limits and segregation of duties.  

  

Support internal and client audits with traceable financial records.  

  

Maintain the documented method behind every reported financial measure so any figure can be reproduced.  

  

**Qualifications:**  

  

7\+ years of experience in financial analysis, management accounting, commercial finance or program finance.  

  

2\+ years of experience leading a finance team or function.  

  

Demonstrated ownership of a contract or program profit and loss, including monthly close.  

  

Demonstrated experience owning billing accuracy against a contractual pricing structure.  

  

Experience building the cost basis for a change order, pricing proposal or business case from actual loaded cost.  

  

Strong modelling capability, and the discipline to show the arithmetic chain rather than only the result.  

  

Experience with enterprise resource planning and reporting environment.  

  

Experience in a service, outsourcing or regulated technical service environment strongly preferred.  

  

**Education/Special Training:**  

  

Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics or business required. Professional accounting qualification preferred.  

  

Training in GxP, data integrity and client site safety provided or required.  

  

Financial system and CMMS training provided after hire.  

  

**Required Competencies:**  

  

Traceability \- every number can be reproduced and will not be published if it cannot.  

  

Commercial Judgment \- builds a case on actual cost rather than an assumed rate.  

  

Billing Rigor \- confirms the contractual basis before the invoice goes out.  

  

Early Warning \- flags margin erosion while it can still be acted on.  

  

People Leadership \- develops analysts and holds the standard on method.  

  

Practicality \- gives operations a number they can act on, not only a report.  

  

Communication \- explains a financial position to operations and an operational reality to finance leadership.  

  

Integrity \- can admit mistakes, is direct and truthful, and acts in the best interest of clients, employees and Renovo.  

  

**Success Measures:**  

  

Program profit and loss against plan  

  

Margin performance by region, site and service line  

  

Monthly close completed on schedule and reconciled

Maintain the documented calculation method behind each recurring report.  

  

**Reporting integrity:**

Support internal and client audits with traceable work.

3\+ years of experience in financial analysis, management accounting, billing or a comparable finance role.

Close deliverables completed on schedule

Site\-level budget versus actual reporting delivered and used  

  

Figures reconciled across reports with no conflicting answers published  

  

Cost analysis supporting conversion and capacity decisions  

  

Audit outcomes on financial working  

  

**Safety Requirements:**  

  

Abide by and follow Renovo safety policies, procedures, and injury and illness prevention expectations.  

  

Maintain a safe working environment for self and others when visiting customer sites, laboratories, offices, or operational environments.  

  

Follow applicable customer site safety requirements, OSHA guidelines, and laboratory or facility\-specific procedures as required.  

  

Complete required safety training assignments on time.  

  

**Physical Requirements:**  

  

Remote, office\-based work.  

  

No routine client site presence. Where a site visit is required, presence in active laboratory environments with required personal protective equipment.  

  

Travel approximately 5 percent, for training and program meetings.

FLSA: Exempt

**About Us**:

CALSTART is now Catalyst Mobility. We are a mission\-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.



For over 30 years, it’s been Catalyst Mobility’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large\-scale, zero\-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. Catalyst Mobility works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real\-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. Catalyst Mobility provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

We are seeking a highly skilled Contracts Analyst to join our team. The candidate **must** have 3\+ years of experience in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating government contracts and subcontracts to support our government contracting processes. This critical role enhances our mission by ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local regulations and successful contract completion. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in government contracts, particularly with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), and California state agency contracts.

* Draft, review, and negotiate complex government contracts, subcontracts, and amendments, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee the full contract lifecycle, including implementation, monitoring, amendments, and closeout, while maintaining a comprehensive repository of contract records.

* Stay informed of changes in contracting regulations and ensure the organization remains compliant with updated requirements. Conduct periodic audits to verify compliance and address any gaps.

### **What You’ll Bring To The Table**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, contract management, law, or a related field; advanced degree or certifications (e.g., CPCM, CFCM) preferred.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in government contract and subcontract management, with expertisei n federal compliance (FAR, CFR).

* Strong negotiation and analytical skills with a proven ability to manage complex agreements.

We value transparency and strives to provide as much information regarding compensation as possible. The complete salary range for this role is $85,000 \- $97,000\. jobs.description:
**Why Renovo?**  

Renovo Solutions is a nationwide healthcare and life sciences technology management company. We offer a range of opportunities for employees to grow within the company. With a presence in 40\+ states and a growing international footprint, we provide comprehensive solutions for managing and maintaining the equipment our clients depend on. We prioritize investing in our employees’ development, offering various phases and advancement paths. Through ongoing training, mentorship programs, and a supportive work environment, we foster professional growth and promote from within. Join our team to make a difference while advancing your career with Renovo.  

  

**Summary:**  

The Program Analyst turns what the Enterprise Laboratory Instrument Services (ELIS) program actually does into evidence the program and the client can act on. This role helps support operational performance analysis, spend and volume trending, and the analysis behind decisions on coverage, capacity and capital replacement.  

  

The role is remote with periodic travel to assigned sites. It reports to the Regional Director of Operations and takes functional direction from the Manager, Master Data and Systems on data and reporting standards.  

  

**What you will do:**  

Contractual performance reporting:  

  

Produce contractual key performance indicators  

  

Maintain the calculation method for each measure in documented form so any figure can be traced and reproduced.  

  

Identify and flag where a contractual measure cannot be produced accurately from available data, and escalate rather than approximate.  

  

Support the quality governance review, which is the only measure in the agreement without an annual cap.  

  

Produce the cost savings evidence, which is the measure the RenovoCare conversion program exists to satisfy.  

  

Prepare performance content for operational reviews, client business reviews and program governance.  

  

Track corrective action triggers and remediation status where a measure breaches its threshold.  

  

**Operational analysis:**  

  

Analyze scheduled maintenance (SM) and demand maintenance (DM) completion, response and resolution performance by site, platform, vendor and department.  

  

Analyze first\-time\-fix, repeat\-fault and aging work order patterns, and identify what is driving them.  

  

Analyze self\-perform versus vendor\-performed volume and the cost difference, and support the conversion case.  

  

Analyze capacity and workload distribution across sites and staff, and flag where load is unsustainable before it fails.  

  

Support capital replacement and end\-of\-life analysis with failure, downtime and spend evidence.  

  

**Spend and commercial analysis:**  

  

Analyze service spending by site, vendor, platform and category, and explain variance against budget in operational terms.  

  

Analyze the contract and entitlement position, including renewal timing, coverage gaps and coverage paid for and not used.  

  

Support quote benchmarking and vendor performance comparison.  

  

Provide the analysis behind change requests, scope changes and pricing discussions.  

  

**Analytical integrity:**  

  

Understand how the work is performed well enough to recognize a figure that cannot be true and investigate rather than publish it.  

  

State the limitations of any analysis, including sample size, data gaps and known record defects affecting the result.  

  

Distinguish correlation from cause and say which one an analysis supports.  

  

Refuse to present a threshold rule or heuristic as a statistical conclusion.  

  

Reconcile any figure appearing in more than one report so the program does not publish two different answers to the same question.  

  

**Working with the sites and functions:**  

  

Act as the named analytical contact for assigned Site Operations Managers.  

  

Travel to assigned sites to understand how the work is actually performed and why the data looks the way it does.  

  

Feed analytical findings back to the sites in a form they can act on, not only upward as reporting.  

  

Work with the Master Data Analyst on record defects that are corrupting analysis, and with Sourcing and Payments on spend and contract data.  

  

Specify and validate reporting and dashboard requirements. This role does not configure or develop the platform.  

  

**Quality, compliance and safety:**  

  

Meet GxP and client data integrity requirements, including traceability and change control on reported figures.  

  

Support internal and client audits with traceable analysis and source data.  

  

Follow client site safety and access requirements when on site.  

  

**Escort and vendor hosting when on site:**  

  

Escort is a standing expectation of every role on this program. When present at a client site, escort and host OEM and third\-party personnel on request, regardless of whose scope the instrument sits in.  

  

Confirm third\-party personnel are inducted, badged, and compliant with client site access and safety requirements before they enter a laboratory.  

  

Confirm the work performed matches what was authorized and the service record is complete before the third\-party leaves site.  

  

Escalate immediately where a third party arrives unannounced or attempts work outside the authorized scope.  

  

**Qualifications:**  

  

3\+ years of experience in operational, service, performance or financial analysis.  

  

Demonstrated ability to produce analysis that has been challenged and held up.  

  

Strong spreadsheet capability including pivot, lookup and reconciliation techniques. SQL, Power BI, Tableau or comparable reporting tool experience preferred.  

  

Experience with a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS), enterprise asset management system or service management platform as a data source.  

  

Experience working to contractual or regulated performance measures w

jobs.title: Senior Program Analyst / Schedule Architect
jobs.description:
**About Blue Water Thinking**



Guided by our principles of value generation, continuous innovation, customer\-centricity, and vested collaboration, Blue Water Thinking proudly supports our Federal clients in achieving their Agency goals.



Founded by a decorated twenty\-eight year Veteran of the United States Army, Blue Water Thinking understands and supports the mission of our Nation's war fighters, Veterans, their families and caretakers.



Leveraging our executive team's military experience and private and public sector consulting expertise, Blue Water Thinking takes an integrated "one\-team" approach and brings to bear best\-fit solutions, thought leadership, and grit to meet our client's transformational needs.



Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.



Lastly, our formula for success is simple: Build something good, take care of our people, keep our clients satisfied, nurture our work ethic and reputation, build long\-lasting partnerships, enjoy what we do and give back as much as possible.

**Job Description:**



Blue Water Thinking is seeking an experienced and dedicated Senior Program Analyst to serve as Schedule Architect and P6 Migration Lead, supporting the Integrated Healthcare Transformation (IHT) initiative at the Department of Veterans Affairs HEFP SEP program. The role carries three linked mandates: architect the target Primavera P6 enterprise environment that a 1,100\+ project portfolio can sustain; map legacy data into logic\-driven schedules without loss of existing data or functionality; and support federal program managers and field staff through the change, with adoption as a key deliverable. All work is advisory; final decision\-making authority rests with the Government, and the incumbent does not draft procurement documents or perform inherently governmental functions.


**Responsibilities:**


***Migration Architecture and Data Mapping***  

* Assess the legacy Microsoft Project Web Access environment and produce a defensible mapping of every legacy data element to its P6 destination, including activity codes, user\-defined fields, WBS levels, calendars, or planned retirement, with rationale documented and Government\-approved.
* Design the enterprise architecture, including EPS hierarchy, WBS standards, activity coding dictionary, calendar library, and UDF strategy sized for portfolio\-scale reporting.
* Develop standardized fragnets and schedule templates by project archetype, including telecommunications room cutovers, data center relocations, elevator modernization, AHU/chiller replacement, and roof replacement.
* Convert milestone\-dominant legacy records into activities with durations and logic while preserving genuine milestones and maintaining legacy reporting during parallel operations until the Government accepts the new reporting.
* Establish and routinely report schedule health criteria, including open ends, negative lag, constraint use, out\-of\-sequence progress, excessive float, and missing predecessors or successors.

***Master Schedule Development, Integration, and Variance Analysis***  

* Build and manage master schedules with full traceability of program and project milestones defined by SEP federal program managers.
* Maintain schedule baselines, control baseline changes, and preserve audit trails of schedule revisions.
* Manage schedule data across design and construction projects spanning EHRM, recapitalization, and targeted infrastructure portfolios.
* Align the EHRM NRM Capital Integrated Schedule with the EHRMIO Integrated Master Schedule and coordinate with Oracle Health and VA stakeholders, including EHRMIO, OIT, OCFM, OAEM, and PCAC.
* Coordinate with VISN and VAMC engineering staff, site engineers, design and A/E firms, and general contractors to gather schedule events and establish dependencies.
* Analyze schedule data for critical path impact, downstream program effects, and schedule variance across deployment sites.
* Identify, quantify, and escalate schedule risks and support maintenance of the SEP risk register using recognized program risk management techniques.

***Coaching, Reporting, and Adoption***  

* Coach and mentor federal program managers, SEP lead engineers, and field staff on schedule interpretation, including critical path, float, milestone movement, and overall program impacts.
* Develop training aids, job aids, bulletins, quick\-reference guides, and SOPs, and provide recurring instruction through office hours, working sessions, recorded walkthroughs, and cohort training.
* Build and maintain Power BI and SharePoint reporting views that present P6 data in accessible terms and monitor adoption to identify areas requiring additional support or design improvements.
* Produce the weekly Capital Integrated Schedule and Risk/Event Report, support Capital Schedule and Variance Reports, and develop executive reporting showing milestone status and variance in clear, non\-technical language.

**Minimum Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Business, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
* Must have previous federal government experience or experience working for a federal contractor.
* 8\+ years of professional scheduling experience supporting design and construction or capital infrastructure programs, including at least 3 years at a senior or lead level within a multi\-project portfolio.
* Demonstrated experience converting a milestone\-based, spreadsheet\-based, or tracking\-register system into a logic\-driven CPM schedule, including responsibility for data mapping and conversion decisions.
* Expert\-level experience with Oracle Primavera P6 Professional and EPPM

jobs.title: Meta Ads Media Buyer (DTC Ecommerce, $10K/day+ Accounts) - Remote, US
jobs.description:
Before you read a word of this: if you have never run $10,000 a day on an ecommerce account, and cannot show me the screen that proves you did, this is not your job. I will save you five minutes.

If you have, keep reading, because the rest of this post is written for you.

**WHAT WE SELL**

A garnet bracelet, to women over sixty who have quietly stopped believing a man will ever cross a room for them again. Direct to consumer. Meta is the engine, Google runs brand and product search behind it, a quiz funnel does the selling. We spend six figures a month and we are scaling into Q4 right now, which is why this seat exists.

**HOW WE WIN, SO YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE WALKING INTO**

Creative is the lever. We do not win on audience tricks or bid hacks, we win because one ad out of a batch becomes a breakthrough and we know how to find it, prove it and scale it. Our best ad right now is an eleven\-minute talk from a stage, built from a nine\-and\-a\-half\-thousand\-word story that reads at a third\-grade level, and it was built out of 400 post\-purchase survey responses we read line by line.

Your job is the other half of that machine. Clean reads. Kill rules set before launch, not in the moment. Scaling the winner without giving back the efficiency. Catching the account problem, the payment hold, the disapproval, the pixel wobble, before it costs a day of Q4\. And telling me the truth about the numbers, especially when the truth is that my favorite ad is losing.

You do not need to know our system on day one. You need to be willing to learn it fast and argue with it in numbers.

**WHAT YOU WOULD ACTUALLY DO**

\- Run the Meta account every day: budgets, launches, kills, scaling. Highest\-volume bidding is our default at this stage; you will be expected to know when that stops being true and to prove it.

\- Launch every creative batch on our tracking codes so every order tells us which ad, which hook and which sale label produced it, and read the results by cost per purchase per cell, not by the dashboard's daily mood.

\- Set the kill rules in writing before a test goes live, so decisions are arithmetic. Use a rolling efficiency floor as the guardrail, because daily ROAS lies while attribution backfills.

\- Design tests that read cleanly: champion against challenger, one variable at a time, never two new things launched on the same day.

\- Scale winners: the budget steps, the campaign duplication, the audience widening, the frequency watch, and the moment to stop. You have done this through at least one Q4 and you remember what broke first.

\- Own the money side of the account with me: spend against cash reserves, spend against stock (our sale reasons are literally true and match inventory, always), spend against the Google brand search that catches what Meta starts.

\- Sit in the creative meeting. You bring the numbers, the comment sections and the hook\-recall data; you help pick what gets built next. Media buyers here have a say in creative because the creative is where the money is.

\- Report weekly in one page: spend, purchases, cost per purchase, blended efficiency, cash, stock days, and what you would do next with the same money.

**WHO THIS IS NOT FOR**

\- You cannot show proof of $10,000 a day or more, on an ecommerce brand, with the dates visible.

\- You have only ever run accounts inside an agency where someone else made the final call and someone else made the creative.

\- Your first explanation for a bad week is the creative, the pixel or the algorithm, in that order, every time.

\- You believe in cost caps, interest stacking, lookalike ladders or any other structure as a matter of faith rather than as a thing you tested against the alternative in the last twelve months.

\- You have never had an account restricted, an ad disapproved or a payment held, or you have and you cannot tell me what you did in the first hour.

\- You want to be left alone with the account. I read the numbers every day. You will be asked what they mean, often.

**WHO THIS IS FOR**

\- You have scaled an ecommerce account past $10K a day and held it there, and you can show the screen.

\- You know why daily ROAS is unreliable and what you look at instead.

\- You write your kill rules down before launch and you can name the last ad you killed on the rule while it still looked fine to everyone else.

\- You have watched an account break under scale, you know what broke, and you fixed it.

\- You want to learn direct response from the inside: the survey file, the sealed copy laws, why a nine\-thousand\-word ad outperforms a thirty\-second one for this customer. You are hungry for that, not tolerant of it.

\- You would rather be right in thirty days at real spend than sound smart on a call.

**WHAT IT PAYS**

Base: $70K/year, set by the proof you bring, not by the interview.

Then the part that matters:

\- A monthly bonus tied to blended efficiency held at scale. You get paid for spending more at the same cost per purchase, not for spending less.

\- A quarterly bonus tied to blended customer acquisition cost across every channel, the number that decides whether this business works.

\- Profit share at the next step up, written into the offer letter with the exact trigger.

**WHERE IT GOES**

This is the first buyer seat in a company that intends to build a growth department, not a seat under an agency. Hold efficiency through one full Q4 at higher spend and you are Senior Media Buyer. Own every paid channel with cost per purchase flat or down for two consecutive quarters and you are Head of Growth, with a budget you allocate across Meta, Google, TikTok and email, a profit share, and hires you choose. The triggers are written down so nobody moves up on tenure or charm, only on numbers that held.

**HOW TO APPLY. READ THIS PART CAREFULLY. IT IS THE FIRST TEST.**

No cover letter. No certifications list. I will not read either.

Apply here on Indeed and put three things in the message box:

1\. Proof.

jobs.description:
**Our Story**
-------------


TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end\-to\-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world\-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.


Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.


We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast\-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

Top Dog Law is one of the fastest\-growing personal injury law firms in the country. We build campaigns that ring phones and fill pipelines — not brand awareness plays. We're seeking a results\-driven Media Buyer to join our performance marketing team, with a primary focus on lead generation across paid digital channels.

  

The ideal candidate has deep hands\-on experience in lead generation media — legal, insurance, home services, or comparable high\-intent verticals. We will also consider strong candidates from ecommerce or CPG backgrounds who demonstrate a clear understanding of lead\-gen funnel dynamics and platform fundamentals.

and bid strategy optimization

* Monitor daily performance across channels — flagging anomalies, scaling winners, and pausing


underperformers through a structured decision\-making process

* Understanding of pixel and data integrity to ensure all events are firing correctly
* Expand into emerging channels as appropriate:
* AppLovin, Programmatic, Display, OLV, streaming, podcasts, CTV
* Loves data, pushes performance. Fast, Hungry, Highly Accountable

**Campaign Management \& Optimization**

* Set up, launch, and continually optimize campaigns across Google Demand Gen, Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Snapchat and additional platforms
* Continually test audiences, creatives, landing pages, and offers — documenting learnings and presenting results
* Manage and adjust budgets, targeting parameters, and bid strategies to maximize qualified lead volume and CPL efficiency
* Coordinate with intake and operations teams to connect ad spend to downstream case quality, using that data to inform ongoing media strategy

* Partner with the creative team to brief ad concepts, provide performance\-based feedback, and identify winning hooks, formats, and messaging angles (familiarity with Motion is a plus)

**Reporting \& Analytics**

* Build and maintain performance dashboards that surface actionable insights on CPL, lead quality, conversion rates, and spend efficiency
* Prepare regular performance updates or reports, covering goals, results, and forward\-looking strategy

Vendor \& Budget Management

verticals

----------------


**With supervisor approval, incumbents may be eligible for intermittent remote work; however, they must physically reside within the Sacramento region or have the ability to regularly report to a City of Sacramento physical worksite with little notice.**
  

This journey\-level classification is populated with multiple incumbents. Incumbents may be assigned to perform either the entire range of support functions and administrative and technical duties for a division or department or a broad range of functional program management duties for programs with department or Citywide impact. Responsibilities require a complete knowledge of departmental policies, programmatic, or project operating policies and procedures. * Interpret and apply rules, regulations, laws, ordinances, and policies.

* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees, the general public, and others contacted in the course of work.
* Review and analyze organizational and administrative problems; recommend and implement effective courses of action.

That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.


Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values\-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.


Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next\-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

**SUMMARY**



The Office of Diversion and Reentry (ODR) is seeking a Health Program Analyst I to support the Referral, Access and Data (RAD) Team. RAD supports ODR's housing access and referral operations across multiple stages of the ODR service continuum, including individuals entering ODR from custody into interim housing placement, and ongoing access to Permanent Supportive Housing (PSH) resources through the county’s Flexible Housing Subsidy Pool (FHSP).



The HPA I will act as a primary liaison between ODR contracted community based providers and the Los Angeles Superior Court to ensure timely bidirectional communication of information, including hearing dates, progress reports, and other court notifications. Additionally, the HPA I will support ODR's court and central release process with housing access for individuals entering ODR, assisting with interim housing referrals and placements, and supporting the management and utilization of ODR's PSH resources.



The HPA I will analyze referral and housing data, monitor resource utilization and placement activity, identify barriers and delays, support data quality and reporting, and assist with improvements to referral and housing\-access workflows. The successful candidate will have strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to coordinate across multiple teams and systems serving individuals with complex housing, behavioral health, and justice needs.



Currently, ODR has a hybrid work schedule with a combination of workdays in the office, in the field and remote. This may change at discretion of Los Angeles Health Services.

* Participate in special projects and analytical assignments as directed by ODR leadership.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Jr. Cost Analyst
jobs.description:
**About us**


We are a team of airline catering enthusiasts who believe flying is the greatest privilege and opportunity in the world and, believe it should be a nice experience for everyone. Air Fayre is an award\-winning catering team that is in search of the best and the brightest to join our dynamic team of airline catering enthusiasts.

**Air Fayre offers benefits including!**

* An excellent compensation package that includes a quarterly performance bonus program.
* Medical, Dental, and Vision for employees \& dependents at 80% premium sponsorship.
* Free short\- and long\-term disability insurance and life insurance
* 2\-4 weeks of paid vacation
* 401K with a match

 **Mission of role**


We’re looking for a detail\-oriented Supply Chain Jr. Cost Analyst to support cost\-data integrity, vendor pricing administration, and foundational supply chain reporting. This role helps protect company revenue by maintaining accurate pricing information, auditing airline and supplier data, flagging discrepancies, and supporting demand\-forecasting activities.


You’ll work closely with supply chain, finance, operations, suppliers, and airline customers to maintain master price records, support RFQ processing, verify system entries, and produce reliable information for senior analysts and business leaders.

**Functions and Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the distribution of Request for Quote (RFQ) templates to suppliers and log returned vendor quotes for senior review.
* Maintain approved supplier cost structures, including labor, overhead, and margin data, in the Scorpio MRP system.
* Upload approved contracts and master pricing updates into Scorpio following monthly airline forecast loads.
* Compare submitted prices with airline system reports, including UAL and AA TP100, TP102, and TP144 reports, to verify prices, effective dates, and codes.
* Update the Master Price List tracking log with submission dates, effective dates, and customer approval statuses.
* Monitor airline reports for zero\-cost codes, pending approvals, and other invoicing discrepancies; compile a monthly exception list for senior analyst review.
* Enter and cross\-reference item and code structures in Scorpio to support accurate demand forecasting.
* Attend customer menu presentations, document key details, verify physical specifications against supporting documentation, and assist with preparatory data gathering.
* Run routine Material Requirements Planning reports and build familiarity with airline data structures, including TP006 reports, variations, and packets.
* Gather baseline data and assist senior analysts with initial calculations for impact analyses, substitution costs, and other ad\-hoc requests.
 **Qualifications \& Educational Requirements**

* At least 2 years of experience in supply chain, finance, data entry, auditing, or a related role.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Finance, Business, or a related field is preferred.
* Previous exposure to a fast\-paced logistics, assembly, airline catering, or food\-services environment is preferred.
* Basic understanding of inventory control, safety stock, demand planning, and how goods move through a supply chain.
* Strong analytical, data\-driven, and detail\-oriented approach, with the ability to investigate unusual cost or inventory movements.
* Ability to set priorities, meet deadlines, follow through on assignments, and collaborate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
**Preferred Skills**

* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Experience with MRP or ERP systems; familiarity with Scorpio is a plus.
* Ability to learn complex systems quickly and maintain accurate, well\-organized records.
* Personable, responsible, and flexible regarding work schedules and hours in a 24/7 operation.

Join us in our mission to uphold the highest standards of quality in our products while fostering a culture of continuous improvement. We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Buyer- TEMP-TO-HIRE
jobs.description:
**Waev Inc.** is an electric mobility OEM founded in 2021 to manufacture, distribute, market, and support the GEM, Taylor\-Dunn and Tiger brands. GEM was the first commercially\-produced, street\-legal low\-speed vehicle in the United States. GEMs shuttle people and goods across city centers, residential communities, government campuses, colleges and universities, and other micro\-environments. Founded in 1949, Taylor\-Dunn burden carriers, personnel carriers, and stockchasers have been trusted solutions in a broad range of commercial environments and provide premium reliability, safety features, and all\-electric efficiency for industrial grade applications. Tiger heavy\-duty tow tractors have been towing cargo, baggage, parcel, and other equipment in ground support applications since 1981\. Waev's headquarters and factory are located in Anaheim, California.




**J****OB SUMMARY**


The Buyer is responsible for purchasing parts, materials, and components to support Waev's manufacturing operations. This is a **fast\-paced, high\-volume role** requiring someone who can effectively manage multiple parts, suppliers, purchase orders, and competing priorities.


The ideal candidate is proactive, detail\-oriented, and has a strong sense of urgency. They are comfortable negotiating with suppliers, pushing back when necessary, resolving shortages, and taking ownership of issues that could impact production.




**ESSENTIAL DUTIESRESPONSIBLITIES:**

* Purchase parts, materials, and components to support daily manufacturing and production needs, including creating and managing multiple POs daily.
* Manage a high volume of parts, suppliers, and open orders while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Monitor supplier performance and proactively follow up on orders, lead times, and deliveries to keep materials moving.
* Identify and resolve shortages, delays, and supply issues quickly to minimize impact to production.
* Partner closely with Production, Engineering, Inventory, and other teams to prioritize material needs and support production schedules.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, terms, and other supplier requirements, while confidently pushing back when necessary.
* Source new suppliers and alternative materials as needed; obtain and evaluate quotes based on cost, quality, availability, and lead time.
* Identify and support cost savings and supplier improvement opportunities.
* Maintain accurate purchasing and supplier information within the ERP/MRP system and resolve PO, pricing, quantity, delivery, and invoice discrepancies.
* Build strong vendor relationships while maintaining accountability, urgency, and follow\-through.




**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* **3\+ years of purchasing, procurement, buying, or relevant manufacturing experience.**
* Experience managing a **high volume of parts, POs, and suppliers** in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems and purchasing processes.
* Experience with supplier negotiations, materials planning, or sourcing preferred.




**KNOWLEGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Strong **negotiation and vendor management skills**, with the confidence to push back and hold suppliers accountable.
* Strong **sense of urgency**, with the ability to respond quickly to production needs and resolve shortages.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, and follow\-through while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Proactive, resourceful, and **solutions\-oriented** with a positive, high\-energy approach.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across teams.
* Ability to creatively source **alternate suppliers and materials** when needed.
* Ability to professionally represent Waev while developing productive working relationships with suppliers.
* Ability to analyze pricing and identify **cost savings opportunities**.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering documentation, drawings, and technical data.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and ERP/MRP systems.




**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Location: On\-site in Anaheim, CA
* Environment: Fast\-paced office/manufacturing/warehouse environment




**EEO Statement**


Waev Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer and will make all employment\-related decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, familial status, status with regard to public assistance, membership or activity in a local commission, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Buyer - Women's and Kids Apparel
jobs.description:
**About the job**


**Position Overview**



The Buyer owns the day\-to\-day category strategy, assortment selection, vendor execution, pricing recommendations, and business performance for assigned categories. This role is accountable, with Planning \& Allocation, for delivering sales, gross margin dollars, inventory efficiency, SKU productivity, and clean inventory exits.



The Buyer must be product\-obsessed, customer\-aware, store\-connected, and financially disciplined. The role requires strong product judgment, vendor management, speed, and willingness to test and learn. The Buyer’s work should make the store easier to shop, improve in\-stock position on priority products, and deliver better value within the defined square footage of the category and Zone.


**Key Responsibilities**



Business Ownership


* Own category performance across sales, gross margin dollars, gross margin rate, inventory productivity, sell\-through, turn, and markdowns.
* Partner with Planning \& Allocation on buy depth, flow, replenishment, inventory risk, and exit strategy.
* Review business results regularly and translate performance into clear actions.
* Identify risks and opportunities early and escalate with recommendations.


Assortment \& Product


* Build customer\-right assortments for assigned categories.
* Build assortments to the category’s defined space within the Zone, balancing customer choice, inventory depth, presentation needs, and productivity.
* Know product features, benefits, quality, durability, use cases, competitive alternatives, and price\-value equation.
* Identify great product that does what it says it does and delivers reliable value without being over\-built or over\-priced.
* Reduce duplication and low\-productivity clutter.
* Use sales per square foot, GM dollars per square foot, inventory per square foot, and turn to improve SKU count, depth, and space allocation recommendations.
* Test new products, brands, classifications, and store\-specific opportunities.


Vendor Management


* Manage vendor line reviews and day\-to\-day vendor relationships.
* Partner with the DMM and Vendor Strategy \& Partnerships on strategic vendor opportunities.
* Push vendors for better product value, availability, funding, product information and marketing assets, and customer storytelling.
* Evaluate vendor productivity and recommend growth, maintenance, reduction, or exit actions.


Pricing, Promotion \& Markdown


* Recommend pricing and promotional strategies based on customer value, competition, margin, and inventory position.
* Partner with Planning on markdown timing, inventory exposure, and exit plans.
* Connect promotions to business objectives and customer relevance.


Cross\-Functional Execution


* Partner with Visual Merchandising and Planning \& Allocation to ensure the assortment fits the space, is easy to navigate, and supports productive inventory placement.
* Partner with Marketing on product stories, campaign priorities, and vendor assets.
* Partner with Stores to understand execution realities and customer feedback.
* Partner with Ecommerce to support online assortment, product content, and drop\-ship opportunities.
* Spend time in stores and use what is learned to improve category decisions.


**Decision Rights**



The Buyer owns or leads:


* Product selection within assigned categories
* Category and classification assortment direction
* Vendor Strategy within the category
* SKU rationalization
* Pricing and promotional recommendations
* Buy depth recommendations in partnership with Planning
* Category space and productivity within the Zone’s standard footprint
* Markdowns and exits
* Product storytelling priorities
* Category test\-and\-learn opportunities


**Measures of Success**



Success in the role will be measured by improvement in:


* Sales
* Gross margin dollars
* Gross margin rate
* Inventory productivity
* Turn
* Sell\-through
* Markdown efficiency
* SKU productivity
* Space productivity, including sales and GM dollars per square foot
* In\-stock position on priority items
* Customer experience and shopability
* Speed of testing, learning, and scaling
* Category productivity
* Vendor support and responsiveness


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**


* 4\+ years of progressive merchandising, buying, category management, or equivalent retail experience; experience owning a meaningful category or high\-SKU business preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in merchandising, business, finance, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
* Strong product curiosity and ability to evaluate quality, value, use case, and competitive position.
* Working command of retail math, gross margin, sell\-through, turn, markdowns, open\-to\-buy, inventory productivity, and space productivity.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, negotiating terms, and developing practical business solutions.
* Proven ability to partner with Planning to deliver sales, GM dollars, inventory efficiency, and clean exits.
* Strong communication, follow\-through, and cross\-functional partnership skills.
* Sporting goods, outdoor, footwear, apparel, fitness, or active lifestyle experience preferred.


**Leadership Expectations**



This role is expected to:


* Put customer value first.
* Know the product and the customer.
* Own the business result.
* Move with speed.
* Test, learn, and adjust.
* Make clear decisions.
* Challenge legacy assumptions.
* Use data without hiding behind it.
* Spend time in stores.
* Build strong cross\-functional relationships.
* Translate strategy into action.


**Salary**



The annual base salary range for this position is from $120,000 \- $140,000\. The range provided includes the base salary that we expect to pay for the role. Offered base salary will be dependent on factors including the scope and complexity of the role, candidate’s related work experience, and subject matter expertise.


**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Camp Gravy is looking for an **organized, proactive Podcast Media Planning \& Buying Manager** with relevant experience to help support a large national brand and their Podcast advertising program. This role combines creative strategy, media operations, billing coordination, and vendor coordination while managing relationships, tracking performance, and crafting compelling talking points that connect with each show’s listeners.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a results\-driven **Digital Media Buyer** with strong experience in **Search Engine Marketing (SEM) and paid search**, particularly Google Ads. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast\-paced agency environment, managing multiple client campaigns and using data to continually improve performance.

The Digital Media Buyer will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management, optimization and reporting of paid media campaigns, with a primary focus on **Google Ads**. Experience with additional digital platforms, including Meta, YouTube and programmatic media, is a plus.

The ideal candidate has at least **2–3 years of hands\-on paid search experience**, understands how to manage campaigns toward lead generation and conversion goals, and is comfortable analyzing performance and making strategic recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

· Plan, build, manage and optimize paid search campaigns across **Google Ads** 

· Manage multiple client accounts, campaigns and budgets simultaneously

· Conduct keyword research and develop effective keyword, match\-type and negative keyword strategies

· Create and test ad copy, campaign structures, audiences and bidding strategies

· Monitor campaign performance and optimize toward KPIs including conversions, CPL, CPA, conversion rate and ROAS

· Manage Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube and other Google campaign types as appropriate

· Analyze search terms, audience behavior, competitive activity and performance trends to identify opportunities

· Monitor pacing and ensure client media budgets are managed effectively

· Work with account, creative and web teams to ensure alignment between advertising, messaging and landing pages

· Assist with conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager, GA4 and troubleshooting campaign measurement

· Develop recurring client reports and translate campaign data into clear insights and actionable recommendations

· Stay current on Google Ads platform changes, AI\-driven campaign capabilities, privacy changes and emerging digital advertising trends

· Support paid social and other digital media campaigns as needed

Qualifications

· **Minimum 2–3 years of hands\-on SEM/paid search experience**, preferably in an agency environment

· Strong working knowledge of **Google Ads**

· Experience with **Microsoft Advertising/Bing Ads** a plus

· Experience managing lead\-generation campaigns and optimizing toward CPL/CPA goals

· Strong understanding of keyword strategy, bidding, audience targeting and conversion optimization

· Familiarity with **GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking**

· Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and identify actionable insights

· Proficiency with Excel and/or Google Sheets

· Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

· Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment

· Strong written and verbal communication skills

· Google Ads certifications preferred

Additional Experience That’s a Plus

Experience with **Meta Ads, YouTube, Performance Max, Demand Gen, programmatic/CTV or other digital media platforms** is a plus. Familiarity with CRM integrations, enhanced conversions, offline conversion tracking and lead\-quality optimization is also valuable.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is both **analytical and proactive**—a media buyer who doesn’t simply monitor campaigns, but actively looks for opportunities to improve performance.

The right candidate will be comfortable digging into the data, testing new strategies, identifying what is and isn’t working, and making recommendations that help our clients generate better results from their digital media investment.

Agency experience is highly preferred, as this position requires the ability to move efficiently between multiple clients, campaigns and priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

jobs.title: Buyer
jobs.description:
Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next\-gen aerospace sector building an end\-to\-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems ("UAS"), aviation\-related physical artificial intelligence ("AI") solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors.



Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members.

**Position Summary**



We are seeking a results\-driven Buyer to join our team in a fast\-paced, evolving aerospace environment. Archer's engineering and manufacturing teams are moving quickly to advance Halo and Thunder toward prototype build and first flight. The Buyer will work closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Finance — often embedded directly with program teams — to turn purchase requests into ordered, received, and inventoried material in minutes and hours rather than days, ensuring timely, cost\-effective material availability that supports our aggressive production schedule and milestones.


**What You'll Do**


* Place purchase orders for production of aircraft material as required by SAP MRP and the manufacturing build schedule
* Manage ordering activity for aircraft material and supporting goods and services, including creating and maintaining all flows to and from Archer's supply base (purchase orders, transfer orders, returns) and indirect purchases such as tools, lab supplies, and other supporting material
* Own the accuracy and timely closure of all open purchase orders, driving cycle time from requisition submission to PO issuance in hours, not days
* Work embedded with engineering, manufacturing, and program teams to translate urgent material needs into purchases within minutes to hours in support of an aggressive, fast\-moving prototype development schedule
* Execute non\-PO purchasing (e.g., P\-Card and approved emergency ordering processes) for time\-critical items in accordance with Finance\-approved cost centers and protocols
* Physically and digitally inventory received parts and proactively notify part owners the moment goods are available for pickup
* Proactively drive purchase order approvals to completion, following up continuously with approvers and stakeholders to prevent schedule\-impacting delays
* Establish and maintain supplier relationships that drive on\-time material deliveries and mitigate supplier risk and schedule delays
* Support pre\-SIOP activities, including projections vs. actuals and PPV reporting, and partner closely with Finance and Accounting to ensure purchase orders are properly routed, coded, and aligned to program budgets
* Resolve invoicing discrepancies to ensure timely supplier payments
* Source aircraft material as needed
* Manage a daily order volume that fluctuates with engineering and assembly demand, at times processing many orders in a single day
* Travel may be required but on an infrequent basis


**What You Need**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain and/or similar business degree
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, highly regulated environment supporting early\-stage aircraft development
* Experience with SAP ERP or an equivalent MRP/procurement system
* Comfortable working onsite and embedded with engineering and manufacturing teams to support urgent, time\-sensitive purchasing needs
* Detail\-oriented, results\-driven, and a strong team player
* Proficient in MS Office Suite \& Google Workspace
* Effective, proactive communicator who can drive approvals and follow\-ups across multiple stakeholders


**Bonus Qualifications**


* Experience in the Aerospace and/or Automotive industry
* APICS certification
* Experience supporting rapid prototyping, first\-article builds, or low\-rate initial production programs


At Archer, we aim to attract, retain, and motivate talent with the skills and leadership needed to grow our business. We drive a pay\-for\-performance culture and reward performance that supports the Company's strategy. For this position, we are targeting a base pay range of $83,700 \- $115,100\. jobs.title: Project Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
The Project Financial Analyst acts as the primary finance business partner to project managers, implementation managers and core project team members supporting all project finance matters including, but not limited to, revenue recognition, cash flow, scope management, change order management, profitability, resourcing, customer support and other project related matters.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Support the project analysis requirements for simple and complex projects and/or contract types; be responsible for the execution of financial processes and preparation of monthly business analysis (e.g. revenues and costs, actuals vs. forecast, variances, cash flow, profitability, cost\-to\-complete, resourcing and scope management ) for defined projects

* Interact and support customer requests
* Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and company policies and standard operating procedures
