* Excellent financial, communication, and interpersonal skills as well as an elevated level of personal motivation to achieve
* Demonstrated ability to work with confidential and sensitive data
* Effective time management and prioritization skills, to manage multiple projects or tasks simultaneously
* Able to perform in depth analysis using various sources of information
* Able to meet deliverable timelines set by the client, project team and company
* Understands the underlying principles of revenue recognition and the relationship between Revenue, Backlog, Work in process and Invoicing
* Ability to travel \<10%

jobs.title: Supply Chain Sr Staff Contracts Analyst
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------



Our Missiles and Fire Control (MFC) Southeast Material Acquisition Center (SEMAC) Supply Chain team is passionate about delivering innovative, affordable, and agile solutions that exceed our customer’s expectations. The supply chain team touches every product and service we deliver and enables our customers to do the impossible every day. We leverage problem solving, creativity, and data to tackle the most exciting challenges in the industry.  

  

Our people are some of the greatest minds in the industry and truly make Lockheed Martin a great place to work.

  

You have arrived at your career destination\~ Join us!

 **Who You Are**  

As a Global Supply Chain Sr Staff Contracts Analyst, you are an experienced professional with a legal, contracts or supply chain management background. You have a comprehensive understanding of the FAR and DFARS with extensive supplier management experience including negotiations and subcontract terms and conditions. You are very comfortable working without appreciable direction and are skilled at providing specialized guidance on contract terms and conditions, regulations, contracting strategies, and other contract matters.  

  

**What You Will Be Doing**  

In this highly visible and fast paced role, the selected candidate will be responsible for advocating for the best interests of the company in contract negotiations and administration, ensuring compliance to policies and regulations, mitigating risk, and partnering with others to obtain positive business results.

  

In this role, you will:

* Manage, review, approve, negotiate, and provide guidance on subcontract terms and conditions for commercial, construction, DOD and international programs, including but not limited to FAR/DFARS requirements, Corporate Documents, End User License Agreements, standard text keys, bailment agreements, economic price adjustment clauses, and model contracts for the procurement of specialized materials, equipment, and services for subcontract systems in support of development, production and global sustainment primes with multiple contract types
* Interpret and understand regulations and contract language to ensure compliance, resolve conflicts, address policy and procedure issues
* Identify, develop, and maintain processes, tools, training and other resources for the benefit of the organization
* Support the mitigation of risks, issues, and opportunities related to contract terms and conditions
* Assists and advises multifunctional subcontract management teams on terms and conditions and subcontract administration issues.
* Provides contract analysis to Global Supply Chain to assist in supplier disclosures, pursuit of remedies, and potential disputes.
* Interface internally and externally with Global Supply Chain, Legal, Contracts, Price/Cost Analysis, and other functional areas at all levels of the organization
**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


* Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university
* Supplier negotiation experience
* Experience with US Government Contracting and the FAR and DFARS
**Desired Skills**
------------------


* Master's degree in a related field and/or Law Degree (JD)
* Experienced and effective communicator (written, verbal and presentation)
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complicated subject matter succinctly to stakeholders and executives
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize effectively and operate efficiently under constrained timelines with multiple priorities
* Experience working for a large defense contractor
* Experience in regulatory compliance, contracts, or supply chain management
* Experience analyzing, resolving, and negotiating supplier exceptions to terms and conditions
* Experience in Federal procurement law and the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC)
* Experience with Solutions Business Manager (SBM) or similar Contracts Management system
* Claims, disputes, disclosures, or remedy experience
* DOD Secret Clearance
**Pay Information**

**GeoZone Definition:** GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost\-of\-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

* Full\-time salary range (GEOZONE 1\): $137100\.00 \- $254700\.00
	+ Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
* Full\-time salary range (GEOZONE 2\): $123400\.00 \- $229200\.00
	+ Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
* Full\-time salary range (GEOZONE 3\): $109700\.00 \- $203700\.00
	+ Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
* Full\-time salary range (GEOZONE 4\): $98700\.00 \- $183300\.00
	+ Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10\), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability, and Long\-Term Disability.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst - Inventory Reconciliation
jobs.description:
Overview:

Intrepid, an SPA Company, brings more than 20 years of experience supporting the Department of Defense and U.S. Government, consistently setting the standard for excellence in the federal marketplace. Committed to advancing the mission of the U.S. Warfighter, Intrepid leverages technological superiority to deliver innovative solutions across air, space, land, and sea domains. We are proud to foster a collaborative, dynamic work environment, offering competitive compensation and an industry\-leading 401k contribution. Our team is built through merit and achievement, and we’re always looking for the best and brightest to join us in our growth. We treat our people like family, we are mission\-focused, and we give back! Join us today.  

SPA has an immediate need for a Financial Analyst\-Inventory Reconciliation.
Responsibilities:

The position focuses on delivering Department of Work (DoW)\-wide inventory reconciliations within Advana or Palantir Foundry to enable accurate financial reporting and audit readiness, including valuation assessments and General Ledger (GL) tie\-outs. This involves creating robust inventory reconciliations for each Working Capital Fund (WCF) DoW agency using advanced data platforms. Key responsibilities include reconciling subledger\-to\-GL tie\-points by mapping quantities, values, and financial line items, as well as tracking Work\-in\-Process (WIP) and in\-transit inventory items to ensure comprehensive oversight. The scope also includes managing inter\-agency transfers, such as handling denials and returns, and establishing traceability to source transactions for improved accountability. Additionally, the role requires harmonizing master data elements like material numbers, Unit Identification Codes (UICs), storage locations, and condition codes to achieve consistency across systems. A critical aspect of this effort is identifying unmatched or unreconciled balances, categorizing them with age buckets and root\-cause codes, and proposing workflow\-driven corrective actions to address discrepancies. This initiative is integral to enhancing inventory management, financial transparency, and operational efficiency across the DoW enterprise.  


Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications:*** Bachelor's Degree
* At least 3 years experience in Subledger\-to\-General Ledger
* At least 5 years experience identifying unmatched/unreconciled balances
* Experience with Advana/Foundry environments
* Active SECRET Clearance and the ability to maintain it throughout employment

Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. new_jobs.title: Administrative Analyst (Fire Department)
new_jobs.description:
**THE POSITION**
----------------


**With supervisor approval, incumbents may be eligible for intermittent remote work; however, they must physically reside within the Sacramento region or have the ability to regularly report to a City of Sacramento physical worksite with little notice.**
  

This journey\-level classification is populated with multiple incumbents. Incumbents may be assigned to perform either the entire range of support functions and administrative and technical duties for a division or department or a broad range of functional program management duties for programs with department or Citywide impact. Responsibilities require a complete knowledge of departmental policies, programmatic, or project operating policies and procedures. The Administrative Analyst may specialize in one program area or may have broader responsibility for multiple internal service functions. Incumbents may independently perform moderately complex professional or program management work and make independent decisions on routine activities; or may perform complex professional or program management work under closer direction and exercise less independent judgment and discretion. The Administrative Analyst is distinguished from the next higher\-level class of Administrative Officer in that the latter is responsible for the administration and management of programs and projects or all centralized administrative services for a department or major division with high visibility and substantial Citywide impact.
   

  

**SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED**
  

General direction is provided by higher\-level department or division administrative personnel. Responsibilities may include the indirect supervision of technical and clerical personnel.
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------


* Performs professional analytical and technical work in the formulation and administration of department or division budgets, development, and management of grants and contracts, management of department level procurement, or coordination of personnel functions.
* Performs research and analysis in the development of program or project activities, including program compliance and eligibility, regulatory issues, and funding requirements.
* Compiles and analyzes data and makes recommendations on the formulation of policy, procedures, staffing, and organizational changes; conducts surveys and performs research and statistical analysis on administrative, fiscal, personnel, or operational problems.
* Compiles materials and assists in the preparation of program\-related grants, budgets, reports, manuals, and publications; coordinates procurement activities and related support functions for a program or project.
* Analyzes information for preparation of grants, contracts, and agreements; assists in negotiating terms; implements, monitors, and prepares reports on conduct and performance; prepares statistical data and graphs.
* Performs research and prepares studies as required; conducts surveys, compiles and analyzes data and formulates program policies and procedures; monitors and evaluates program effectiveness and outcomes; prepares periodic or specialized reports of program activities.
* Participates and assists in the design, implementation, and installation of new and revised programs, systems, procedures, methods of operation, and forms.
* Coordinates and monitors the administrative functions of an assigned department; compiles materials and assists in the preparation of budgets, reports, manuals, and publications.
* Coordinates departmental activities and programs with other City departments and divisions, and with outside agencies; represents the assigned department in committee meetings; oversees contract service providers.
* Responds to complaints and requests for information; interprets and applies policies and procedures; adjudicates complaints.
* Makes complex program or project eligibility determinations; conducts focus groups; meets with community or business groups.
* Prepares oral reports; makes oral presentations to a variety of City and departmental committees.
* May train staff as assigned.
* Provides exceptional customer service to those contacted in the course of work.
* Other related duties may also be performed; not all duties listed are necessarily performed by each individual holding this classification.
**QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------


**Knowledge of:**


* Principles and practices of personnel administration.
* Principles and practices of organization and public administration.
* Principles and practices of program management, analysis, and coordination.
* Principles and practices of program performance measurement, systems analysis, and statistical measurement.
* Research techniques, methods, and procedures, and basic methods of statistical analysis.
* Principles, methods, and practices of municipal finance, budgeting, and accounting.
* Principles, methods, and practices of procurement, contracting, and grant writing.
* Methods of reporting information.
* Applicable Federal, State, and local laws and regulations.

  

**Skill in:**
* Providing customer service, including dealing with people in sensitive situations and problem resolution.

new_jobs.title: Financial Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.


Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values\-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.


Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next\-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.


At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

 **The Job**

  

The Financial Analyst assists the manager in leading the department to ensure accurate system configuration, capitation payment processing, accruals, shared risk pool calculation, and claims expense recording. Interprets contractual agreements to ensure system accuracy and compliance. Manages databases and ensures that provider payments are accurate. Ensures data integrity for audit and bid process for all entities.

 **You Will**

  

* Facilitates and leads intradepartmental meetings required for audit, accruals, data analysis, annual Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) bids, capitation and claims reserves Oversees timely and accurate completion of all shared risk pool settlements on a quarterly and annual basis and provides guidance for the team on technical aspects of contract language
* Liaison with Network Management, Shared Services, Claims, Legal, Actuary, Compliance and Enrollment to ensure accuracy of provider contract application in the system for explicit capitation calculations and payment On\-going testing, validation, monitoring and financial reporting of the capitation module with continued efforts relating to processes improvement, CMS guidelines and system upgrades
* Responsible for the maintenance and data integrity of the capitation and shared risk modules by managing the configuration, analysis documentation, and testing of the system set\-up to support current and future operational needs and compliance requirements Mentors team by providing guidance, support, and assisting with escalated issues and tasks, as needed
* Assures timely and accurate monthly provider capitation payments Creates system documentation, including process flow and desk top procedures
* Ensures compliance by evaluating new, proposed, and existing contractual agreements as they relate to payment methodologies for both capitated and shared risk arrangements (Medical Groups, Hospitals, and Ancillary Providers) Timely response and resolution to Network Management inquiries
* Provides management with planning and control information by assembling and analyzing historical financial data, identifying trends, providing forecasts, explaining processes and techniques, recommending actions and revisions and departmental improvements, as needed Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results, as needed
* Ensures CMS bid accuracy by providing detailed and complex capitation and accrual data (member level detail) on a GAAP to incurred basis
* Collaborates and provides analytical support to the Finance, Network Management, Pharmacy and Health Care Informatics departments by assimilating data from multiple sources into clear meaningful reports in support of specific accruals and reserves for multiple programs and entities
* Compiles and presents complex capitation information by organizing and explaining data, assumptions and recommendations, as needed.
* Initiates membership and payment audits and ensures efficiency in the capitation process
* We seek Rebels who are curious about AI and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members.
* Actively support the achievement of SCAN’s Vision and Goals.
* Other duties as assigned.

 **Your Qualifications**

  

* Associate's Degree or Technical Degree or equivalent experience.
* 3\-5 years of related experience.
* Performs work under minimal supervision. Handles complex issues and problems, and refers only the most complex issues to higher\-level staff. Possesses comprehensive knowledge of subject matter.
* Provides leadership, coaching, and/or mentoring to a subordinate group but does not directly supervise.
* Technical expertise \- Advanced analytical skills.
* Problem Solving \- Basic problemsolving skills.
* Communication \- Good communicationand interpersonal skills.
* Microsoft Office Suite at advanced level required.

 **What's in it for you?**

* Base salary range: $60,400 to $92,602 per year
* Work Mode: Mostly Remote
* An annual employee bonus program
* Robust Wellness Program
* Generous paid\-time\-off (PTO)
* Eleven paid holidays per year, plus 1 floating holiday, plus 1 birthday holiday
* Excellent 401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with employer match and contribution
* Robust employee recognition program
* Tuition reimbursement
* An opportunity to become part of a team that makes a difference to our members and our community every day!

  

We're always looking for talented people to join our team! Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply now!

  

At **SCAN** we believe that it is our business to improve the state of our world. Each of us has a responsibility to drive Equality in our communities and workplaces. We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects our community through inclusive programs and initiatives su

Responsibilities

The Senior Cost Analyst should be capable of the following:
* Plan and develop cost estimates, perform risk analyses, and generate required estimate documentation
* Work with program managers, technical teams, senior leaders, contractors, team lead, and other teammates to develop program descriptions, strategies and acquisition documents
* Research technical designs, identify cost drivers, collaborate with cost research teams, determine estimating methodologies, and build dynamic estimates that credibly model system costs
* Be able to comfortably, confidently, and accurately present results to Government customers and their chain of command
* Provide data\-driven insights and make recommendations to Government customers
* Analyze development and production contractor’s data, generate independent cost projections and assessments to our customers, and support Government source selection processes
* Support and participate in technical and program management reviews
* Advise the Program Managers, Chief Financial Officer, Portfolio Acquisition Executive, and other leaders with accurate, concise, and defendable cost positions
Skills Required
* **US Citizenship Required**
* Active TS/SCI clearance required
* 8\-15 years of cost estimating and analysis experience supporting DoD/DoW, National Reconnaissance Office (NRO), Intelligence Agency, National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), or National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) customers

 **Mission of role**


We’re looking for a detail\-oriented Supply Chain Jr. Cost Analyst to support cost\-data integrity, vendor pricing administration, and foundational supply chain reporting. This role helps protect company revenue by maintaining accurate pricing information, auditing airline and supplier data, flagging discrepancies, and supporting demand\-forecasting activities.


You’ll work closely with supply chain, finance, operations, suppliers, and airline customers to maintain master price records, support RFQ processing, verify system entries, and produce reliable information for senior analysts and business leaders.

**Functions and Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the distribution of Request for Quote (RFQ) templates to suppliers and log returned vendor quotes for senior review.

* Update the Master Price List tracking log with submission dates, effective dates, and customer approval statuses.
* Monitor airline reports for zero\-cost codes, pending approvals, and other invoicing discrepancies; compile a monthly exception list for senior analyst review.

* At least 2 years of experience in supply chain, finance, data entry, auditing, or a related role.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Finance, Business, or a related field is preferred.
* Previous exposure to a fast\-paced logistics, assembly, airline catering, or food\-services environment is preferred.
* Basic understanding of inventory control, safety stock, demand planning, and how goods move through a supply chain.

**Preferred Skills**

* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Experience with MRP or ERP systems; familiarity with Scorpio is a plus.
* Ability to learn complex systems quickly and maintain accurate, well\-organized records.
* Personable, responsible, and flexible regarding work schedules and hours in a 24/7 operation.

Join us in our mission to uphold the highest standards of quality in our products while fostering a culture of continuous improvement. We look forward to your application!

new_jobs.description:
**Waev Inc.** is an electric mobility OEM founded in 2021 to manufacture, distribute, market, and support the GEM, Taylor\-Dunn and Tiger brands. GEM was the first commercially\-produced, street\-legal low\-speed vehicle in the United States. GEMs shuttle people and goods across city centers, residential communities, government campuses, colleges and universities, and other micro\-environments. Founded in 1949, Taylor\-Dunn burden carriers, personnel carriers, and stockchasers have been trusted solutions in a broad range of commercial environments and provide premium reliability, safety features, and all\-electric efficiency for industrial grade applications. Tiger heavy\-duty tow tractors have been towing cargo, baggage, parcel, and other equipment in ground support applications since 1981\. Waev's headquarters and factory are located in Anaheim, California.




**J****OB SUMMARY**


The Buyer is responsible for purchasing parts, materials, and components to support Waev's manufacturing operations. This is a **fast\-paced, high\-volume role** requiring someone who can effectively manage multiple parts, suppliers, purchase orders, and competing priorities.


The ideal candidate is proactive, detail\-oriented, and has a strong sense of urgency. They are comfortable negotiating with suppliers, pushing back when necessary, resolving shortages, and taking ownership of issues that could impact production.




**ESSENTIAL DUTIESRESPONSIBLITIES:**

* Purchase parts, materials, and components to support daily manufacturing and production needs, including creating and managing multiple POs daily.
* Manage a high volume of parts, suppliers, and open orders while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Monitor supplier performance and proactively follow up on orders, lead times, and deliveries to keep materials moving.
* Identify and resolve shortages, delays, and supply issues quickly to minimize impact to production.
* Partner closely with Production, Engineering, Inventory, and other teams to prioritize material needs and support production schedules.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, terms, and other supplier requirements, while confidently pushing back when necessary.
* Source new suppliers and alternative materials as needed; obtain and evaluate quotes based on cost, quality, availability, and lead time.
* Identify and support cost savings and supplier improvement opportunities.
* Maintain accurate purchasing and supplier information within the ERP/MRP system and resolve PO, pricing, quantity, delivery, and invoice discrepancies.
* Build strong vendor relationships while maintaining accountability, urgency, and follow\-through.




**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* **3\+ years of purchasing, procurement, buying, or relevant manufacturing experience.**
* Experience managing a **high volume of parts, POs, and suppliers** in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.

new_jobs.title: Buyer - Women's and Kids Apparel
new_jobs.description:
**About the job**


**Position Overview**



The Buyer owns the day\-to\-day category strategy, assortment selection, vendor execution, pricing recommendations, and business performance for assigned categories. This role is accountable, with Planning \& Allocation, for delivering sales, gross margin dollars, inventory efficiency, SKU productivity, and clean inventory exits.



The Buyer must be product\-obsessed, customer\-aware, store\-connected, and financially disciplined. The role requires strong product judgment, vendor management, speed, and willingness to test and learn. The Buyer’s work should make the store easier to shop, improve in\-stock position on priority products, and deliver better value within the defined square footage of the category and Zone.


**Key Responsibilities**



Business Ownership


* Own category performance across sales, gross margin dollars, gross margin rate, inventory productivity, sell\-through, turn, and markdowns.
* Partner with Planning \& Allocation on buy depth, flow, replenishment, inventory risk, and exit strategy.
* Review business results regularly and translate performance into clear actions.
* Identify risks and opportunities early and escalate with recommendations.


Assortment \& Product


* Build customer\-right assortments for assigned categories.
* Build assortments to the category’s defined space within the Zone, balancing customer choice, inventory depth, presentation needs, and productivity.
* Know product features, benefits, quality, durability, use cases, competitive alternatives, and price\-value equation.
* Identify great product that does what it says it does and delivers reliable value without being over\-built or over\-priced.
* Reduce duplication and low\-productivity clutter.
* Use sales per square foot, GM dollars per square foot, inventory per square foot, and turn to improve SKU count, depth, and space allocation recommendations.
* Test new products, brands, classifications, and store\-specific opportunities.


Vendor Management


* Manage vendor line reviews and day\-to\-day vendor relationships.
* Partner with the DMM and Vendor Strategy \& Partnerships on strategic vendor opportunities.
* Push vendors for better product value, availability, funding, product information and marketing assets, and customer storytelling.
* Evaluate vendor productivity and recommend growth, maintenance, reduction, or exit actions.


Pricing, Promotion \& Markdown


* Recommend pricing and promotional strategies based on customer value, competition, margin, and inventory position.
* Partner with Planning on markdown timing, inventory exposure, and exit plans.
* Connect promotions to business objectives and customer relevance.


Cross\-Functional Execution


* Partner with Visual Merchandising and Planning \& Allocation to ensure the assortment fits the space, is easy to navigate, and supports productive inventory placement.
* Partner with Marketing on product stories, campaign priorities, and vendor assets.
* Partner with Stores to understand execution realities and customer feedback.
* Partner with Ecommerce to support online assortment, product content, and drop\-ship opportunities.
* Spend time in stores and use what is learned to improve category decisions.


**Decision Rights**



The Buyer owns or leads:


* Product selection within assigned categories
* Category and classification assortment direction
* Vendor Strategy within the category
* SKU rationalization
* Pricing and promotional recommendations
* Buy depth recommendations in partnership with Planning
* Category space and productivity within the Zone’s standard footprint
* Markdowns and exits
* Product storytelling priorities
* Category test\-and\-learn opportunities


**Measures of Success**



Success in the role will be measured by improvement in:


* Sales
* Gross margin dollars
* Gross margin rate
* Inventory productivity
* Turn
* Sell\-through
* Markdown efficiency
* SKU productivity
* Space productivity, including sales and GM dollars per square foot
* In\-stock position on priority items
* Customer experience and shopability
* Speed of testing, learning, and scaling
* Category productivity
* Vendor support and responsiveness


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**


* 4\+ years of progressive merchandising, buying, category management, or equivalent retail experience; experience owning a meaningful category or high\-SKU business preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in merchandising, business, finance, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
* Strong product curiosity and ability to evaluate quality, value, use case, and competitive position.
* Working command of retail math, gross margin, sell\-through, turn, markdowns, open\-to\-buy, inventory productivity, and space productivity.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, negotiating terms, and developing practical business solutions.
* Proven ability to partner with Planning to deliver sales, GM dollars, inventory efficiency, and clean exits.
* Strong communication, follow\-through, and cross\-functional partnership skills.
* Sporting goods, outdoor, footwear, apparel, fitness, or active lifestyle experience preferred.


**Leadership Expectations**



This role is expected to:


* Put customer value first.
* Know the product and the customer.
* Own the business result.
* Move with speed.
* Test, learn, and adjust.
* Make clear decisions.
* Challenge legacy assumptions.
* Use data without hiding behind it.
* Spend time in stores.
* Build strong cross\-functional relationships.
* Translate strategy into action.


**Salary**



The annual base salary range for this position is from $120,000 \- $140,000\. The range provided includes the base salary that we expect to pay for the role. Offered base salary will be dependent on factors including the scope and complexity of the role, candidate’s related work experience, and subject matter expertise.


**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Our curated assortment features some of the most relevant brands and styles in the world, including adidas, Brandy Melville, Fear of God Essentials, alongside Pacsun’s own labels and exclusive collaborations.

 The primary responsibility of the Senior Buyer is to identify opportunities and develop product strategies within their categories that align to the overall strategic vision of the company to drive revenue growth. * Works with the planning organization to develop assortment plans that optimize inventory performance and reduce markdown risk.
* Ensure key milestones are maintained based on master calendar.
* Strategically directs the category groups. Drive execution through staff to meet or exceed both quantifiable and quantitative goals.

* Develop and execute seasonal promotional strategies.
* Drive floorset execution with visual team, and partner with marketing team on seasonal campaigns.

* Oversee/participate in market visits.
* Establish and maintain effective vendor relationships and works with the buyers to strengthen market relationships.
* Travel, as needed.

  


**TEAM DEVELOPMENT (30%):**

* Hire and retain team members that will leverage their strengths to the needs of the organization.
* Coaches and develops Buyers, Associate Buyers and Assistant Buyers ensuring growth and readiness for next level position.
* Manage and mentor staff. Create development and succession plans.
* Live the company values; trust, teamwork, creativity, individual excellence, passion

* Bachelor’s Degree desired with 3\-5 years retail buying experience in either specialty store or department store. Internal candidates must have at least 2 years of Buyer level buying experience.
* Excellent knowledge of Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Must have strong communication skills, providing direction to private label, design and product development team and brands.
* Ability to work as a team member
* Must be task driven and pro\-active when it comes to executing tasks
* Thorough knowledge of retail Math such as gross margin, open to buy calculations, initial markup calculations, turnover etc.

new_jobs.title: Digital Media Buyer – SEM/Paid Search
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a results\-driven **Digital Media Buyer** with strong experience in **Search Engine Marketing (SEM) and paid search**, particularly Google Ads. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast\-paced agency environment, managing multiple client campaigns and using data to continually improve performance.

The Digital Media Buyer will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management, optimization and reporting of paid media campaigns, with a primary focus on **Google Ads**. Experience with additional digital platforms, including Meta, YouTube and programmatic media, is a plus.

The ideal candidate has at least **2–3 years of hands\-on paid search experience**, understands how to manage campaigns toward lead generation and conversion goals, and is comfortable analyzing performance and making strategic recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

· Plan, build, manage and optimize paid search campaigns across **Google Ads** 

· Manage multiple client accounts, campaigns and budgets simultaneously

· Conduct keyword research and develop effective keyword, match\-type and negative keyword strategies

· Create and test ad copy, campaign structures, audiences and bidding strategies

· Monitor campaign performance and optimize toward KPIs including conversions, CPL, CPA, conversion rate and ROAS

· Manage Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube and other Google campaign types as appropriate

· Analyze search terms, audience behavior, competitive activity and performance trends to identify opportunities

· Monitor pacing and ensure client media budgets are managed effectively

· Work with account, creative and web teams to ensure alignment between advertising, messaging and landing pages

· Assist with conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager, GA4 and troubleshooting campaign measurement

· Develop recurring client reports and translate campaign data into clear insights and actionable recommendations

· Stay current on Google Ads platform changes, AI\-driven campaign capabilities, privacy changes and emerging digital advertising trends

· Support paid social and other digital media campaigns as needed

Qualifications

· **Minimum 2–3 years of hands\-on SEM/paid search experience**, preferably in an agency environment

· Strong working knowledge of **Google Ads**

· Experience with **Microsoft Advertising/Bing Ads** a plus

· Experience managing lead\-generation campaigns and optimizing toward CPL/CPA goals

· Strong understanding of keyword strategy, bidding, audience targeting and conversion optimization

· Familiarity with **GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking**

· Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and identify actionable insights

· Proficiency with Excel and/or Google Sheets

· Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

· Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment

· Strong written and verbal communication skills

· Google Ads certifications preferred

Additional Experience That’s a Plus

Experience with **Meta Ads, YouTube, Performance Max, Demand Gen, programmatic/CTV or other digital media platforms** is a plus. Familiarity with CRM integrations, enhanced conversions, offline conversion tracking and lead\-quality optimization is also valuable.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is both **analytical and proactive**—a media buyer who doesn’t simply monitor campaigns, but actively looks for opportunities to improve performance.

The right candidate will be comfortable digging into the data, testing new strategies, identifying what is and isn’t working, and making recommendations that help our clients generate better results from their digital media investment.

Agency experience is highly preferred, as this position requires the ability to move efficiently between multiple clients, campaigns and priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain and/or similar business degree

* Experience in the Aerospace and/or Automotive industry

new_jobs.description:
Overview:

Intrepid, an SPA Company, brings more than 20 years of experience supporting the Department of Defense and U.S. Government, consistently setting the standard for excellence in the federal marketplace. Committed to advancing the mission of the U.S. Warfighter, Intrepid leverages technological superiority to deliver innovative solutions across air, space, land, and sea domains. We are proud to foster a collaborative, dynamic work environment, offering competitive compensation and an industry\-leading 401k contribution. Our team is built through merit and achievement, and we’re always looking for the best and brightest to join us in our growth. We treat our people like family, we are mission\-focused, and we give back! Join us today.  

SPA has an immediate need for a Financial Analyst\-Inventory Reconciliation.
Responsibilities:

The position focuses on delivering Department of Work (DoW)\-wide inventory reconciliations within Advana or Palantir Foundry to enable accurate financial reporting and audit readiness, including valuation assessments and General Ledger (GL) tie\-outs. This involves creating robust inventory reconciliations for each Working Capital Fund (WCF) DoW agency using advanced data platforms. Key responsibilities include reconciling subledger\-to\-GL tie\-points by mapping quantities, values, and financial line items, as well as tracking Work\-in\-Process (WIP) and in\-transit inventory items to ensure comprehensive oversight. The scope also includes managing inter\-agency transfers, such as handling denials and returns, and establishing traceability to source transactions for improved accountability. Additionally, the role requires harmonizing master data elements like material numbers, Unit Identification Codes (UICs), storage locations, and condition codes to achieve consistency across systems. A critical aspect of this effort is identifying unmatched or unreconciled balances, categorizing them with age buckets and root\-cause codes, and proposing workflow\-driven corrective actions to address discrepancies. This initiative is integral to enhancing inventory management, financial transparency, and operational efficiency across the DoW enterprise.  


Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications:*** Bachelor's Degree
* At least 3 years experience in Subledger\-to\-General Ledger
* At least 5 years experience identifying unmatched/unreconciled balances
* Experience with Advana/Foundry environments
* Active SECRET Clearance and the ability to maintain it throughout employment

Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.
